lines.english: In the marshes of the wide Altai,
lines.note: The form ‘баткалда’ is uncertain; read here as referring to marshy or muddy ground.

lines.english: While the Kyrgyz lay there grieving,
Days dragged on and nights passed,
Summer passed and autumn reached its midpoint,
It was the season when livestock grew fat;
Was pregnant and had developed cravings.
He slaughtered eighty mares from the horse herd,
Yet she was not satisfied with that meat,
Did not stop craving at all.
A set of nine animals, headed by a camel,
He also laid the meat he had slaughtered.
